method: Read-only Python UTF8 walker using the canonical JS scanner known patterns and JSON credential field rules. Node/browser/DB/tests were not run. All suspected values excluded from output.

falsePositiveAdjudication.reason: Human authorization metadata only, scoped to the exact source file hash/path/field; not a global key allowlist.

scope: Heuristic known-pattern check only; zero unresolved candidates after explicit adjudication does not prove universal absence of secrets. Binary/image pixels or metadata are not scanned; manual image attestations are separate. Root final canonical scan must include later LOAD/other artifacts.
